2022-23 Panini Flawless Basketball provides a high-end finish for '22-23 NBA collectors. Per Panini, all memorabilia showcased in the release is game-worn, including the first game-used cards for the rookie class.

Issued in metal briefcases, Hobby boxes supply eight autographs and one relic. There are also 1st Off the Line (FOTL) direct from the Panini website. These have one exclusive Bill Russell Tribute Patch (1/1), nine additional autograph or memorabilia cards, and two exclusive Bronze Diamond cards (/3).
Gemstones, game-worn memorabilia and the always-in-demand Logoman cards give the 2022-23 Panini Flawless Basketball checklist plenty of chase pieces.
Of course, the NBA product comes with a huge price tag, with boxes pushing well into the thousands.

Joining the autographs and relics, 2022-23 Panini Flawless Basketball is home to various gem cards. Many of these have diamonds, including Base Gems, Legends, Flawless Drafts and Flawless Championships, each limited to 20 copies or less.
Each FOTL box adds two exclusive Bronze Diamond (/3) cards.
There are also more elaborate multi-gem versions, such as the one-of-one "The Finals" card with 11 diamonds.

As usual, autographs abound in the 2022-23 Panini Flawless Basketball checklist. Look for Excellence Signatures, Flawless Finishes, Flawless Patch Autographs, Signature Prime Materials, Star Swatch Signatures, and more.
One-of-one chases arrive in Logoman Autographs and Laundry Tags Autographs.
As mentioned, all relic cards in 2022-23 Panini Flawless Basketball have game-worn swatches.
The one-of-one Bill Russell Tribute Patch naturally honors the former great. These are exclusive to FOTL boxes.
The Triple Logoman series returns to give an added boost to the pricey product.
